title: Learning Commonsense-aware Moment-Text Alignment for Fast Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: In this paper, to tackle the dilemma of speed-accuracy tradeoff, we propose a commonsense-aware cross-modal alignment (CCA) framework, which incorporates commonsense-guided visual and text representations into a complementary common space for fast video temporal grounding.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Specifically, the commonsense concepts are explored and exploited by extracting the structural semantic information from a language corpus.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: In this paper, to tackle the dilemma of speed-accuracy tradeoff, we propose a commonsense-aware cross-modal alignment (CCA) framework, which incorporates commonsense-guided visual and text representations into a complementary common space for fast video temporal grounding.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Finally, to maintain the original semantic information of textual queries, a cross-modal complementary common space is optimized to obtain matching scores for performing FVTG.
